lead_headline: Villa Tourism Reaches New Heights in Kalkan
lead_deck: Villa tourism is on the rise in Kaş and Kalkan.
lead_body: Villa tourism in Kaş and Kalkan has recently reached new heights. According to a report by Yeni Alanya, this region holds an important place in villa tourism. Tourists are particularly preferring villas in Kaş and Kalkan.
